nodes.label: HackYourWay Claude Guidance (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Auto-generated guidance doc consolidating active tech stack (C#12/.NET8/Godot4.6), project structure, commands, code style conventions, and recent migration notes (Unity6→Godot4.6).

nodes.label: HackYourWay README (Game Overview)
nodes.rationale: Original README describing terminal hacking idle game commands: scan, crack, show, inject, firewall, copy, ls, ransomware. Documents attack order and planned store/contracts/bot-scripting features.

nodes.label: RecreateUI — Godot Editor Steps & Manual Test Guide
nodes.rationale: Documents all manual Godot editor work that cannot be automated: scene creation, resource files (.tres), font import, input map, renderer settings. Companion to tasks.md for the Unity→Godot migration.

nodes.label: Migration Tasks (Unity → Godot 4.6)
nodes.rationale: Tracks 21 tasks (T001–T021) across 6 phases for the feature/moving-to-godot migration: Godot project files, Data Resources, Core Systems, UI Layer, Tests, Speckit Artifacts. All tasks marked complete.

nodes.label: Skill: graphify (Knowledge Graph Builder)
nodes.rationale: Converts any folder of files into a navigable knowledge graph with community detection, HTML viz, GraphRAG-ready JSON, and GRAPH_REPORT.md. Supports BFS/DFS query, path finding, wiki generation, MCP server mode, Neo4j export.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-analyze (Cross-artifact Consistency Analysis)
nodes.rationale: Read-only analysis across spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md to find inconsistencies, duplications, ambiguities. Requires all three artifacts to exist. Constitution is non-negotiable authority.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-checklist (Requirements Quality Checklist)
nodes.rationale: Generates unit-tests-for-English checklists validating completeness, clarity, consistency of requirements (not code correctness). Scoped to current feature via .specify/ directory.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-clarify (Spec Ambiguity Reduction)
nodes.rationale: Asks up to 5 targeted questions to identify underspecified areas in feature spec, encodes answers back into spec.md. Expected to run before /speckit-plan.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-constitution (Project Constitution Manager)
nodes.rationale: Creates or updates .specify/memory/constitution.md by filling template placeholders with project-specific values and propagating amendments to dependent artifacts. Uses semantic versioning for the constitution itself.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-git-commit (Auto-commit Hook)
nodes.rationale: Invoked as before/after hook by core speckit commands. Reads git-config.yml event keys to decide whether to git add + git commit. Gracefully degrades when Git unavailable.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-git-feature (Feature Branch Creator)
nodes.rationale: Creates and switches to a new feature branch using sequential (001-) or timestamp (YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-) numbering. Branch naming strategy read from git-config.yml or init-options.json.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-git-initialize (Git Repo Initializer)
nodes.rationale: Runs git init + initial commit if not already in a repository. Supports customization for .gitignore, LFS, hooks, signing. Gracefully skips when Git is absent.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-git-remote (Git Remote URL Detector)
nodes.rationale: Detects origin remote URL and extracts owner/repo for GitHub integration. Supports HTTPS and SSH formats. Returns empty result without error when remote absent.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-git-validate (Feature Branch Validator)
nodes.rationale: Validates current branch matches sequential (^[0-9]{3,}-) or timestamp (^[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6}-) naming conventions and checks for corresponding spec directory under specs/.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-implement (Task Executor)
nodes.rationale: Executes all tasks in tasks.md, checking checklists for completeness before proceeding. Respects before/after hooks from extensions.yml.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-plan (Implementation Planning)
nodes.rationale: Generates implementation plan artifacts: research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md. Loads spec.md and constitution.md, validates against constitution gates, stops after Phase 2.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-specify (Feature Spec Creator)
nodes.rationale: Creates or updates spec.md from natural language description. Generates a short-name, optionally triggers git branch creation via before_specify hook, creates spec feature directory under .specify/.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-tasks (Task Generator)
nodes.rationale: Generates dependency-ordered tasks.md from plan.md, spec.md, optional data-model.md, contracts/, research.md. Organizes tasks by phase and user story priority.

nodes.label: Skill: speckit-taskstoissues (Tasks→GitHub Issues Sync)
nodes.rationale: Converts tasks.md entries into GitHub Issues via GitHub MCP server. Only proceeds if remote URL points to github.com. Enforces strict repo-match safety guard.

nodes.label: Spec-Kit Extensions Configuration (extensions.yml)
nodes.rationale: Configures hooks for all speckit lifecycle events (before/after: constitution, specify, clarify, plan, tasks, implement, checklist, analyze, taskstoissues). Git extension wired as mandatory hook for before_constitution and before_specify; auto-commit as optional for all others.

nodes.label: Git Extension Config Template (config-template.yml)
nodes.rationale: Template copied to git-config.yml on install. Configures branch_numbering strategy (sequential/timestamp), init commit message, and per-command auto_commit toggles with message templates. All auto_commit defaults to false.

nodes.label: Migration: Unity 6 → Godot 4.6 (feature/moving-to-godot)
nodes.rationale: Full engine migration replacing MonoBehaviour→Node, TMP→RichTextLabel, Unity Input→InputEvent, JsonUtility→System.Text.Json, ScriptableObject→Resource, coroutines→_Process state machine, Unity Test Framework→GDUnit4.

nodes.label: Git Extension Manifest
nodes.author: spec-kit-core
nodes.rationale: Declares the Git Branching Workflow extension v1.0.0 for Spec Kit. Provides feature branch creation, numbering, validation, remote detection, and auto-commit hooks tied to all Spec Kit lifecycle events.

nodes.label: Git Extension Configuration
nodes.rationale: Runtime config for the git extension: branch_numbering strategy (sequential/timestamp), init_commit_message, and per-command auto_commit enable/message overrides. Only after_plan is enabled by default.

nodes.label: speckit.git.commit Command
nodes.rationale: Auto-commit hook: reads auto_commit config, determines event name from hook context, runs git add . + git commit. Gracefully skips when git is unavailable, config is missing, or nothing to commit.

nodes.label: speckit.git.feature Command
nodes.rationale: Creates feature branches with sequential (001-) or timestamp (YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-) numbering. Supports GIT_BRANCH_NAME env override. Outputs JSON with BRANCH_NAME and FEATURE_NUM.

nodes.label: speckit.git.initialize Command
nodes.rationale: Initializes a git repo (git init + git add . + git commit) if one does not exist. Hooked to before_constitution. Skips gracefully when git is unavailable or already inside a repo.

nodes.label: speckit.git.remote Command
nodes.rationale: Detects git remote origin URL; extracts owner/repo and confirms if remote is GitHub. Supports HTTPS and SSH URL formats. Returns empty result (no error) if git is unavailable or no remote configured.

nodes.label: speckit.git.validate Command
nodes.rationale: Validates current branch against sequential (^[0-9]{3,}-) or timestamp (^[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6}-) naming patterns. Checks for matching spec directory under specs/. Falls back to SPECIFY_FEATURE env var.

nodes.label: HackYourWay Project Constitution
nodes.rationale: Version 2.0.0 (ratified 2026-04-13, amended 2026-05-11). Migrated from Unity to Godot 4.6. Four core principles: Code Quality (SRP, partial keyword), Testing Standards (GDUnit4+NUnit, TDD), UX Consistency (terminal-style unified command output), Performance (45 FPS, 22.22ms frame budget, no hot-path allocations). Quality gates: Build, Test, Performance, UX, Constitution Check. Governance requires MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH versioning.

nodes.label: Agent File Template (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Template for auto-generated CLAUDE.md project guidance files. Sections: Active Technologies, Project Structure, Commands, Code Style, Recent Changes. Includes MANUAL ADDITIONS markers.

nodes.label: Checklist Template
nodes.rationale: Template for /speckit.checklist output. Defines checklist item format (CHK001-N), category groupings, and check-off notation. Sample items must be replaced with feature-specific items.

nodes.label: Constitution Template
nodes.rationale: Template for /speckit.constitution output. Defines structure: Core Principles (up to 5+), additional sections, Governance block with versioning policy. Version/Ratified/Last Amended footer required.

nodes.label: Implementation Plan Template
nodes.rationale: Template for /speckit.plan output. Sections: Summary, Technical Context (Language/Version/Dependencies/Storage/Testing/Platform/Performance/Constraints/Scale), Constitution Check gate table, Project Structure (doc tree + source tree), Complexity Tracking table.

nodes.label: Feature Specification Template
nodes.rationale: Template for /speckit.specify output. Sections: User Scenarios (prioritized P1-Pn, each independently testable with Given/When/Then acceptance scenarios), Requirements (FR-NNN), Key Entities, Success Criteria (SC-NNN), Assumptions.

nodes.label: Tasks Template
nodes.rationale: Template for /speckit.tasks output. Phases: Setup, Foundational (blocks all stories), User Story phases (P1 MVP first, each independently testable), Polish. Task format: [ID] [P?] [Story] Description. Dependency ordering enforces TDD (tests FAIL before implementation).

nodes.label: 001 Hacking Idle Core — Data Model
nodes.rationale: Defines all enumerations (SecurityLevel, MalwareType, CurrencyType, ToolType, ContractType, FirewallStatus, StoreItemCategory) and core entities (Location, Network, Device, DeviceFile, Malware, Player, StoreItem, Contract, Objective, SaveData). Relationships: Location 1-* Network 1-* Device 0..1 Malware. Player references StoreItems and Contracts. SaveData is the JSON-serialized aggregate.

nodes.label: 001 Hacking Idle Core — Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Original plan targets Unity 6 (C# 9, .NET Standard 2.1, URP 2D, JsonUtility, ScriptableObjects). Branch: develop. Architecture: TickManager (timer-based, not Update), CommandParser (registry pattern), ICommand/ITickable interfaces, ScriptableObject-defined currencies and store items. Constitution Check passes all 4 gates. Full source tree documented.

nodes.label: 001 Hacking Idle Core — Quickstart Guide
nodes.rationale: 10-step end-to-end validation guide: start game, scan networks, inspect/crack networks, scan devices and disable firewalls, inject malware, check infected devices, offline income, store upgrades, contracts, performance check (Profiler, 45 FPS, no hot-path GC).

nodes.label: SaveData Aggregate
nodes.rationale: JSON-serialized root aggregate: PlayerSaveData (balances as List<CurrencyBalance> for JsonUtility compat), List<LocationSaveData> (nested Networks/Devices), and schema version int.

nodes.label: TickManager Architecture Concept
nodes.rationale: Timer-based income tick system (not per-frame Update). Chosen to satisfy Performance principle: zero per-frame GC allocations in idle income path.

nodes.label: CommandParser Registry Pattern
nodes.rationale: ICommand registry pattern for terminal command dispatch. No LINQ in hot path; use for loops to avoid GC. One class per command verb.

nodes.norm_label: feature 001: hacking idle core — requirements checklist

nodes.label: Feature 004: Location Network Persistence — Data Model
nodes.norm_label: feature 004: location network persistence — data model

nodes.label: Currency (Game Entity)
nodes.rationale: Progressive multi-currency. Starts with Bitcoin; altcoins unlock via store upgrade milestones. double precision to avoid float loss at large idle numbers.

nodes.label: scan Command
nodes.rationale: First invocation lists networks; second invocation moves to new location. Subforms: scan network {SSID}, scan ip {IP}, scan mac {MAC}.

nodes.label: crack Command
nodes.rationale: Syntax: crack {WEP|WPA|WPA2} {SSID}. Requires tool ownership matching security level. Sets Network.isHacked=true on success.

nodes.label: inject Command
nodes.rationale: Syntax v1.0: inject {miner|bot|spammer|ransomware}. Requires targeted device with DISABLED firewall. Extended to v1.1 with optional {IP} {SSID} direct-resolve form.

nodes.label: firewall Command
nodes.rationale: Syntax: firewall {disable|enable}. Requires FirewallDisable tool. Toggles Device.firewallStatus.

nodes.label: show Command
nodes.rationale: Subforms: show networks (all discovered networks with hack status), show ips (infected devices with malware type and income rate).

nodes.label: ls Command
nodes.rationale: Lists files on currently targeted device. Required for file-retrieval contracts.

nodes.label: copy Command
nodes.rationale: Copies a file from targeted device to player storage. Required for file-retrieval contracts.

nodes.label: TickManager Service
nodes.rationale: Timer-based tick at 1-second interval using InvokeRepeating (not per-frame Update). Maintains ITickable subscriber list. Chosen over per-frame accumulation to prevent GC pressure and framerate coupling.

nodes.label: OfflineIncomeCalculator Service
nodes.rationale: On load, computes elapsedSeconds = (now - max(malware.installedAt, player.lastSave)) / TicksPerSecond, then income = elapsedSeconds * incomeRate. Full offline accrual, no cap. UTC timestamps prevent timezone drift.

nodes.label: CommandParser Service
nodes.rationale: Dictionary<string, ICommand> registry. Tokenizes input by whitespace; first token = verb. Command pattern isolates each verb for independent unit testing. Extended in feat003 with GetRegisteredVerbs() for autocomplete.

nodes.label: SaveSystem Service
nodes.rationale: JSON serialization via JsonUtility to Application.persistentDataPath/save.json. SaveData aggregate. Save triggered on quit, pause, and significant state changes.

nodes.label: LocationService
nodes.rationale: Generates Location+Networks+Devices from LocationConfigSO using deterministic seed (location ID as PRNG seed). Extended in feat002 with virtual GetCurrentLocation() for testability.

nodes.label: IncomeService
nodes.rationale: Implements ITickable. On each tick iterates active Miner/Spammer malware (for loop, no LINQ) and credits Player.balances. Multiplier updated by StoreService on PC component purchase.

nodes.label: StoreService
nodes.rationale: Validates purchase (balance check, not-already-owned). Deducts balance. Applies effect: adds ToolType, adds CurrencyType, sets income multiplier on IncomeService.

nodes.label: ContractService
nodes.rationale: Availability gated by Player malware injection status (bot required for attack contracts). Tracks objective completion. Credits reward on full completion.

nodes.label: TerminalController (UI)
nodes.rationale: Wires InputField submit to CommandParser. Extended in feat003 with Update() for Tab/Up/Down key interception, CommandHistory wiring, and autocomplete via GetRegisteredVerbs().

nodes.label: TerminalOutputView (UI)
nodes.rationale: Scrollable output panel. AppendLine() with StringBuilder. Extended in feat003: Canvas.ForceUpdateCanvases replaced with WaitForEndOfFrame coroutine + _scrollPending guard to prevent frame spikes.

nodes.label: HUDController (UI)
nodes.rationale: Displays BTC balance via TMP. Updates every TickManager tick. Caches last value to skip redundant refreshes. Formats as BTC: {value:F4}.

nodes.label: CommandHistory Model
nodes.rationale: Plain C# class (not MonoBehaviour). List<string> _entries capped at 50. _navIndex=-1 means not navigating. Session-only, no persistence. NavigateBack/Forward return null to signal clear-field.

nodes.label: SaveData Model (v2)
nodes.rationale: Root save object with Version, Player, Locations list, CurrentLocationName (v2 new), NextLocationId. Migration: v1->v2 back-fills Name and CurrentLocationName.

nodes.label: LocationSaveData Model
nodes.rationale: Id (string/seed), Name (derived: int.Parse(Id)*77%1000), ConfigId, IsVisited, Networks list.

nodes.label: ForgetResult Value Type
nodes.rationale: Returned by LocationService.ForgetNetwork() and ForgetDevice(). Fields: Success, Message, IpsRemoved. Ambiguous factory for SSID found at multiple locations.

nodes.label: SelectionState (TerminalController internal)
nodes.rationale: Nullable struct in TerminalController for multi-choice prompts. Options array + HighlightIndex + OnSelected callback. Cancel always appended as last entry.

nodes.label: TDD Principle (Constitution Principle II)
nodes.rationale: Tests MUST be written and confirmed failing before implementation (Red-Green-Refactor). Applied consistently across all features.

nodes.label: No LINQ in Hot Paths (Constitution Principle IV)
nodes.rationale: Unity docs prohibit LINQ in hot paths to avoid GC allocations. IncomeService uses for loops. InjectCommand TryResolveDevice uses for loops. 22.22ms frame budget constraint.
nodes.norm_label: no linq in hot paths (constitution principle iv)

nodes.label: Command Schema Versioning
nodes.rationale: Any change to a command signature is a breaking change requiring schema version bump. v1.0.0 initial, v1.1.0 adds optional inject {IP} {SSID}. Non-breaking: optional args preserve backward compatibility.

nodes.label: Offline Income Calculation Design
nodes.rationale: Uses max(installedAt, lastSave) to prevent over-counting for malware installed mid-session. UTC timestamps. Full offline accrual with no cap.

nodes.label: Procedural Network Generation Design
nodes.rationale: Location ID used as PRNG seed for deterministic reproducible generation. LocationConfigSO defines distributions. Prevents hand-authoring every network while keeping saves reproducible.

nodes.label: Deferred Scroll Strategy (WaitForEndOfFrame)
nodes.rationale: Replaces Canvas.ForceUpdateCanvases() (heaviest Unity UI call) with one-shot end-of-frame coroutine. Batches multiple AppendLine calls into single layout pass. _scrollPending guard prevents coroutine stacking.

nodes.label: Direct Inject by IP/SSID Design
nodes.rationale: Player.TargetedDevice NOT updated in direct-inject path (targeting exclusive to ScanCommand). Current location only searched (cross-location ambiguity). virtual on GetCurrentLocation() instead of full interface.
